1s Lock and Release

The width of the phone clamp can be adjusted. Turn the knob counterclockwise to expand the width of the phone clamp, put the phone in, and then turn the knob clockwise to clamp the phone. Finally lock the safety lock to firmly fix the phone.

Does not Block the Camera

The motorcycle phone holder adopts a semi-enclosed design and will not block the phone camera. Supports taking pictures and videos while riding.

Easy to Install

When installing, just rotate the button to adjust the handlebar clamp. The handlebar clamp is suitable for bicycles, motorcycles, electric scooters, strollers, shopping carts, indoor bicycles, treadmills. Suitable for handlebar diameter: 0.71-1.57 inches (18-40mm).

Wide Compatibility

This motorcycle phone holder can accommodate all phones from 2.56-3.78 inches (65-96mm) wide, for example, phones with a diagonal size of 4.5-7 inches, and the maximum thickness that the phone holder can accommodate is 0.59 inches (15mm).

360° Rotation and Sturdy

The adjustable bicycle phone holder comes with a 360-degree rotating ball, which allows you to adjust your phone to a horizontal or vertical viewing angle while riding. The rubber pads on the phone clamp protect your phone from scratches and slipping. The bicycle phone handlebar clamp can tightly hold the handlebars, ensuring your phone is safe and stable on bumpy roads.
